description: Agent Travel: submit the itinerary as booked with the trip as requested: the request with the traveler, the origin and destination codes, whether a return was requested, the earliest departure and latest arrival for the outbound and the return, the shortest workable connection in minutes, the most connections each way and the longest layover accepted in hours (6 when left out); and the booking with its reference, the traveler and each segment with its id, kind, from and to, departure and arrival with their offsets, carrier, number and direction (outbound or return). The signed report gives the request, the booking, the traveler on the request beside the traveler on the booking, each direction with its endpoints, first departure and last arrival read against the requested places and times, and every connection with its place and length in minutes against the minimum, and counts them, and names a mismatched itinerary: another traveler on the booking, a direction that leaves from or arrives at another place, a time outside the request, a segment that leaves from somewhere other than where the one before it arrived, a connection under the shortest workable one and a requested return left unbooked; then a connection within 30 minutes of the minimum, a layover past the longest accepted and more connections than accepted, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No traveler on either side, no requested endpoints or times, no minimum connection or connecting segments with no times leave the itinerary unverified. This reads one booked itinerary against the trip requested: a trip planned, booked and held on Wever is read by wever_sports-trip-status and assembled by wever_sports-plan-trip, and a purchase’s terms against its governing terms are wever_terms-match-check. Verdict travel_itinerary_mismatched, travel_itinerary_partial, travel_itinerary_unverified or travel_itinerary_matching. POST /api/travel-itinerary-check. Reads the travel records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, booking or external write. Agent Travel reads a travel purchase an agent made, after the fact, from the traveler’s own records: the booking against the travel authorization, the itinerary against the trip as requested, the passenger details against the traveler’s ID, the fare rules against what the buyer was told, a change and a cancellation against the fare rules, the extras against what was authorized and needed, and a disruption against the carrier’s stated policy. Beside it, the Sports Trips tools such as wever_sports-trip-status plan, book and read a trip held on Wever, while a travel check reads a purchase made anywhere against its own records; wever_delegated-authority issues and reads the grant itself, while the authorization check reads one booking’s price, dates and class against the travel authorization behind it; and the Tokenized Asset Purchase checks such as wever_tokenized-quote-check read a tokenized asset purchase, while a travel check reads a travel booking. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-travel-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-travel/.
